evals.prompt: Make the inventory screen for my RPG look good: a window, item slots in a 6x4 grid, and icons for sword, shield, bow, hp potion, mp potion, key, gold, wood.
evals.expected_output: Inventory list with sizes on the 8px grid; window as 9-slice with margins reported; slot.svg + slot-selected via states; 8 icons at 32px designed at 32; ui_check icons run, closest pairs named and fixed by shape; manifest.json; no text baked in; rarity stated as frame color.

evals.prompt: I need a HUD for a tower defense: gold and wood counters, wave indicator, base HP bar, and a build button with states.
evals.expected_output: Counters as pill frames + 24px icons; wave frame with engine text area; HP bar delivered as frame + fill files; primary button with 4 states derived from one SVG; nine-slice check passes on every panel; nothing text/number baked.

evals.prompt: Here is my panel.svg (attached). When Godot stretches it the top border looks smeared. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Runs ui_check nine-slice first, reports which band fails and the neighbour diff, moves ornaments into corner squares, keeps gradient direction along the stretch axis, re-checks, returns margins.

evals.prompt: Draw a legendary sword for the reward screen, 256px.
evals.expected_output: Recognises this is featured item art, not an icon; routes to svg-character-design item art (or does it there), optionally noting the 32px icon should share the silhouette.
